answer: Exclusive escrowed capital is the scarce resource: each identity locks 60 units for 45 days in a canyon vault before acting, and escrow issues one raven receipt bound to its key. The registry records each collateral hash; verifiers reject a receipt whose hash backs another identity, and a signed double-commit proof drops both weights to zero and slashes both locks. Splitting 60 units across two keys leaves a delta below the full lock for each, so it cannot be pooled. An honest agent locks 60 once, back after 45 clean days; 1,000 fakes must lock 60,000 units for the full term.
